name: Freedom Dollar
oneLiner: FUSD is the Zano privacy-chain dollar token; public reserve details and redemption mechanics are limited, and it is not bridged to tracked Pharos chains.
collateral: FUSD is minted against ZANO reserves deposited into the Freedom Dollar DAO contract, with initial overcollateralization above 1000%. Reserves are staked on Zano and publicly visible on-chain.
pegMechanism: Algorithmic Zano-backed mint/redemption design: users mint FUSD by depositing ZANO into the Freedom Dollar DAO, with very high initial overcollateralization and on-chain reserve visibility.

oracleRisk.summary: Public docs reviewed for Freedom Dollar do not identify the collateral oracle setup or failure handling.

blacklistabilityReview.sourceFreeRationale: Resolved from the follow-up FreezeWatch audit: FUSD is a Zano Confidential Asset and the public project materials do not identify a direct token freeze, blacklist, pause, seize, or arbitrary-burn surface.
blacklistabilityReview.upstreamSuppressionRationale: The text-based resolver can infer upstream exposure from ZANO reserve language, but ZANO reserve volatility is collateral risk, not an issuer or upstream stablecoin freeze surface under FreezeWatch semantics.
blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Follow-up audit retained: FUSD resolves to No because existing metadata and public materials describe ZANO-backed minting without an identified direct or upstream freeze authority.

reserves.name: Zano ecosystem collateral and reserve mechanisms

notices.title: Unsupported private chain
notices.message: FUSD primarily circulates on Zano, which is not a configured Pharos chain, so no contract is stored.

mintAuthority.summary: FUSD is issued as a Zano Confidential Asset and is described by the project as an autonomous, over-collateralized ZANO-backed mint with no admin keys, but Zano is a privacy chain with no EVM smart contracts, so the mint authority and any admin surface cannot be independently inspected.

review.evidence: Project materials describe FUSD as a permissionless, over-collateralized stablecoin minted by depositing ZANO into an autonomous protocol, with no central issuer or admin keys. Because Zano enforces confidential transactions and uses native Confidential Assets rather than auditable EVM contracts, the mint authority and any privileged control cannot be verified on-chain, so the mint path is left unknown.
review.sourceFreeRationale: Mechanism description comes from Freedom Dollar project materials; the underlying Zano privacy chain provides no auditable contract surface to confirm or refute the autonomous, admin-keyless mint claim.
unresolvedQuestions: Zano is a privacy-chain using Confidential Assets with no auditable EVM contract surface; the FUSD mint authority and admin-keyless claim cannot be verified remotely. Resolution requires Zano-native tooling or direct issuer disclosure of collateral contract parameters.
